replacements.old: - [ ] Formalize developmental potential separately from current capability.
replacements.new: - [x] Formalize developmental potential separately from current capability. — ✅ PR #909 / #908 DP-1: current capability is the present protected score; potential is the maximum score over the complete budget-reachable developmental set; headroom is their difference. Potential is coordinatewise budget-monotone, while crossed witnesses prove current score alone does not identify it. Exact 1,512-case replay is zero-failure.

- [x] Define evolvability quantitatively. — ✅ PR #909 / #908 EV-1: at a registered finite useful-descendant set, `Ev_Q(U)=Q(U)`; fixed iid proposals with mass `p>0` have exact expected first-hit count `1/p`, while zero mass returns typed `UNREACHABLE_ZERO_USEFUL_MASS`. Exact 105 kernel/useful-set cases are zero-failure; proposal count is not physical runtime.

replacements.old: - [ ] Derive conditions under which history improves future discovery rather than merely storing solutions.
replacements.new: - [x] Derive conditions under which history improves future discovery rather than merely storing solutions. — ✅ PR #909 / #908 HIST-1: for a held-out useful set disjoint from storage, positive masses `p0,pH`, priced proposal burden `c>0`, and history overhead `h>=0`, history strictly improves expected discovery iff `h+c/pH<c/p0`; ties, harm, and zero-mass cases stay distinct. Exact 300-case replay is zero-failure.

replacements.old: - [ ] Distinguish solution capital from search-policy improvement.
replacements.new: - [x] Distinguish solution capital from search-policy improvement. — ✅ PR #909 / #908 CAPITAL-1: a stored useful target with unchanged proposal law is solution capital, not policy improvement; a strictly cheaper changed discovery law on a held-out target absent from storage is search-policy capital, not recall. Contaminated assays fail closed; exact 24 target/storage cases are zero-failure and empirical K2 remains unclaimed.
